name: Quick Chat
afterHooks: cd $RELEASE_PATH && cp $BASE_PATH/.env $RELEASE_PATH/.env && docker compose -p chat-app -f compose.prod.yaml down --remove-orphans || true && docker compose -p chat-app -f compose.prod.yaml up -d --remove-orphans --build && sleep 10 && docker exec chat-app-prod-php php artisan migrate --force
